items.title: A Hacker Who Stole $270 Million Is Moving It Into Tornado Cash. Can Stolen Crypto Ever Be Recovered?

items.title: CME Group (CME) Stock Looks Fully Valued After Its 69% Run
items.summary: CME Group has delivered a solid share price run over the past few years, which naturally puts a spotlight on whether that climb is backed up by the returns it earns on the capital sitting inside the business. With the stock recently closing at US$311.56, the real question for you is how much of that history the current market value is already assuming. Over the past 5 years, CME Group has returned 68.6%. This raises the stakes on whether the company’s underlying returns on capital are strong...
